name: The Slipped Snare
summary: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws and Misty Step a few times a Long Rest. The price: one Hit Point lost per level, and Disadvantage on Insight checks.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's (the breached vault's X33d); the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_breached_vault (the breached vault off the vault stair).

benefit.text: Blows land half an inch from where you stood, and when trouble comes you are already somewhere else.

cost.flaw: Half of you is always leaning toward the next step, and your body is a little less hardy for it.
cost.text: Once you know how easy it is to slip out of sight, you can never again believe anyone is quite who they claim to be.
